import bleach # Define the allowed tags and attributes for safe rendering ALLOWED_TAGS = [ "b", "i", "strong", "em", "p", "br", "ul", "ol", "li", "a", "blockquote", "code" ] ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = { "a": ["href", "title", "rel"], } # Ensure links open in a new tab and are safe ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS = bleach.sanitizer.ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS.union({"mailto"}) # Predefined HTML template with placeholders INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def prepare_event_details(headline: str, summary: str, scheduled_date: str, additional_info: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or name of the event. summary : str A comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs and formatting). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date of the event. additional_info : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for secure display of the event invitation. Raises ------ ValueError If any required argument is missing or empty. """ # Basic validation of required fields for name, value in [("headline", headline), ("summary", summary), ("scheduled_date", scheduled_date)]: if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip(): raise ValueError(f"Argument '{name}' must be a non-empty string.") # Sanitize each component safe_title = bleach.clean(headline, tags=[], attributes={}, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS) safe_summary = bleach.clean( summary, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS ) safe_date = bleach.clean(scheduled_date, tags=[], attributes={}, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS) safe_additional = bleach.clean( additional_info, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS ) # Render the template with sanitized content html_output = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_summary, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_additional ) return html_output.strip()
